text: Here's how to play Slana, in about two minutes.
Slana is agar dot io, on-chain. You're a coin in a live arena on Solana. Eat smaller players, take their tokens, and cash out whenever you like.
Start for free. In the lobby, pick the Practice ticket and press Quick Play. No wallet, no tokens: just you and the bots. Practice has two leagues, Rookie and Pro.
Your coin follows the mouse.
Press Space to split, and launch half of your coin at a runner.
Hold W to tip out a little mass.
Number keys one to eight send stickers, and Enter opens the chat.
Eat confetti to grow. To eat a coin, you need a quarter more mass than it has, and you have to mostly cover it.
So run from bigger coins. And the bigger you get, the slower you move.
Rug cacti pop big coins into pieces. Small coins can hide behind them.
Bots carry no value. But if a bot eats you, your tokens spill on the floor as loot, and only real players can grab it.
Ready to play for real? Connect a wallet and buy a ticket. Every arena has a fixed entry fee. Penny Pond is one thousand Slana, Silver Creek ten thousand. Gold Lake and Whale Bay are Pass rooms.
Your entry fee is your starting value, and it sits in your till. Eat a player, and their tokens move into it.
To cash out, press C and survive three seconds without losing a cell. Your receipt prints, and the tokens go to your wallet.
The fee is charged on profit only. Enter with one thousand, cash out at two thousand: that's one thousand profit. The five percent fee is fifty, so you get nineteen fifty.
With a Pass, the fee is two percent. That's twenty, and you keep nineteen eighty.
Fees split three ways: half to the treasury, thirty percent to the season pool, and twenty percent is burned.
The Slana Pass is a free-mint NFT. It opens the Pass rooms, drops the fee to two percent, and gives you a fifteen percent head start and a two-second cash-out.
Season points come only from Pass tickets, and the top ten win prizes from the season pool.
Quick tips. Warm up in Practice. Only split when the catch is sure: a split coin is easy prey. And cash out while you're ahead.
Slana. Eat. Grow. Cash out.
